name: Mercenary Company Conversion
desc: A permanent planetary-yard conversion for the Cerberus. Adds 18 personnel capacity and company barracks, command facilities and a single workshop gantry at the cost of 25 cargo capacity. Retains one ship boat berth. Install through Mercenary conversion at an accessible planetary spaceport for 5,000 credits. Boats and mechs must be commissioned separately.
short: Converts a Cerberus into a compact mercenary company vessel.
